title: STATE ToxiCN: A Benchmark for Span-level Target-Aware Toxicity Extraction in Chinese Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM performance (via fine-tuning and API prompting) on span-level extraction of Target-Argument-Hateful-Group quadruplets from Chinese text to assess their ability to identify explicit and slang-based sexist hate speech.

Evaluating LLM performance on span-level extraction of Target-Argument-Hateful-Group quadruplets from Chinese text to assess their ability to identify racist hate speech and culturally specific racial slurs.

Evaluating LLM performance on span-level extraction of Target-Argument-Hateful-Group quadruplets from Chinese text to assess their ability to identify regional discrimination and stereotypes (e.g., bias against specific provinces).
Evaluating LLM performance on span-level extraction of Target-Argument-Hateful-Group quadruplets from Chinese text to assess their ability to identify anti-LGBTQ hate speech and slang.
